description: This file defines the Crc32ValidatingParser class, which decorates a parser to validate the CRC32 checksum from the x-amz-crc32 header in AWS API responses.

classes.name: Crc32ValidatingParser
classes.description: A parser decorator that validates the CRC32 checksum from the AWS response headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a callable parser to decorate.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the parser, validating the CRC32 checksum from the response headers.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a member from a stream to the wrapped parser.
